critic.fix_suggestion: Apply a purple color override to the vertical stabilizer geometry. If using a primitive box or cylinder for the tail, ensure it is positioned at the rear of the fuselage with a height-to-width ratio of 2:1. For the branding, place a small gold sphere (radius 0.5% of wing span) on the center of the tail's exterior face to represent the emblem.
